scope: Additional development controls on previously seen clips; not held-out assessment
notes: References were prepared by independent inspection of original and privacy-processed images and tracks, without new model outputs.
Only the four-field question files are inference inputs. Rubrics remain separate.
Human validation of reference answers is still required.

The freeze precedes the first complete 48-question rerun and every first control output. An earlier intermediate bus-clarity diagnostic was not consulted by the control authors. Later code revisions reuse these as development checks, not fresh held-out data.
